feeds.title: Mod Barbies Blog
feeds.description: An engaging, fun, one-stop resource for Mod Barbies and her friends! Here you will find Fun blog posts about your favorite Mod Barbies and her friends. Learn more about your favorite Mod Era Barbies! I'm an avid collector & would love to share photos and stories from my collection with you.

feeds.title: Barbie Sequel
feeds.description: The website 'Barbie Sequel' focuses on the rise of 'Film Democracy' and its impact on the selection of the next 'Barbie Sequel' movie. It emphasizes the shift from traditional studio-dominated decision-making to a more inclusive, audience-driven approach. This movement not only embraces inclusivity but also strategically aligns with market dynamics to enhance the film's success and appeal.

feeds.title: The Barbie Blog
feeds.description: A place to showcase Barbie collection and learn more about them. I love to snatch up dolls at yard sales and thrift stores, give them a spa day and make them fabulous! If you are on the hunt for a particular type of doll, you can probably find it on here.

feeds.title: Dutch Fashion Doll World
feeds.description: A Dutch Barbie collector in Holland. My name is Rogier and I'm from Holland. I started collecting dolls last august so I'm quite new in the fashion doll world.

feeds.title: Inside the Fashion Doll Studio
feeds.description: I am an avid Silkstone and Fashion Royalty collector who enjoys photographing her collection. I enjoy sharing tips I have learned about doll photography and collecting as well as making and displaying dioramas.

feeds.title: Fashion Dolls at Van's Doll Treasures
feeds.description: Van's Doll Treasures primarily features Barbie and other fashion dolls her size. I make and sell 1/6 scale doll furniture for Barbie and Ken. The link to my Etsy shop is available on the right hand side. I prepare dioramas and videos that feature my doll families.

feeds.title: Plastically Perfect
feeds.description: Whether you're looking for photoshop makeup tips, DIY projects, diorama builds, or just a healthy dose of fashion for the ultimate fashionista herself (Barbie), you've come to the right place. This blog is written by, and for, adult doll hobbyists and collectors.

feeds.title: Her Obsession errr My Obsession
feeds.description: Our family addiction to dolls started out with my Paternal Grandmother. I have always loved to collect Barbies, Bears and toys in General.

feeds.title: Barbie Doll and Friends
feeds.description: I love all things vintage! Clothes, shoes, jewellery, recipes, toys, cars, music, radios, telephones, aeroplanes, WW2 history and MORE! I started collecting Barbies when I was 13 and still collect to this day!

feeds.title: I-Luv-Dolls
feeds.description: I am a collector of Black Barbie dolls, Barbie dolls, fashion dolls and action figures. I had a large doll collection as a child that even included a black Francie and a Julia doll. Once I became older, I still loved dolls but didn't play with them as much.

feeds.title: Can You Keep a Secret? Barbie Movies Confessions
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to confessions about Barbie movies, as well as other Barbie things! The confessions box is always open! Please see rules before submitting. Run by queen-erika-the-songful
